# How-To: Bloodied Pistolero Build

![](/uploads/ajaxGallery_28_nukaknights-post-build-bloodied-pistols.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

## UPDATE AFTER PATCH 22:

Perception now needs 6 points since Panzerkiller now also counts for pistols.

The legendary perks Aftereffect and Full Commitment improve the build enormously.

New video attached: BE 10mm vs Brandbeast

## BEFORE PATCH 22:

This build only plays with pistols. He mostly uses 10mm automatic pistols, but can also switch to single shots and play with 10mm pistols as well as revolvers, improv, laser pistols or black powder pistols. The advantage of 10mm pistols is readily available ammunition, speed, many mods, silencers, both automatic and single shot possible. Above all, he relies on increased damage when sneaking. Of course, weapons with silencers work better here.

## WEAPONS

BE15 10mm pistol (automatic or single shot), BE 44 revolver, BE Impro revolver, quadruple (+ body part damage) Western revolver, VE 10mm pistol. All 10mm pistols with silencers (for sneak attacks and Sandman buffs at night), Bloodstained Gauss Pistol

## ARMOR

Mixed Unyielding/Chameleon armor with "harder to detect while sneaking" and weapon weight reduction. The pistol shooter, like my sniper build, relies on sneak attacks to maximize damage and effectiveness.

For the silos, this character also has complete problem-solver armor with him. (See "Launching Nuclear Missiles" tutorial).

Backpack can be added as desired. e.g. the apothecary's backpack of the raiders to save the card "Travel First Aid Kit" and instead play "Strongly Built" i.e. reducing the weight of armor.

## SKILL SET

**Strength** 5

First aid kit 3, weapon belt 2

**Perception** 3

Concentrated Fire 3

**Endurance** 8

Lifegiver 4, Fireproof 3, Radicool 1

**Charisma** 3

By the Dozen Stranger 1, Meat Tenderizer 2 (or alternatively Inspirational 2)

**Intelligence** 8

Demolition expert 5, nerd rage 3

**Agility** 15

Guerrilla 3, Professional Guerrilla 3, Master Guerrilla 3, Covert Operations 3, Peng-Fu 1, Sandman 2,

**Luck** 14

Bloody Death 3, Grim Reaper Sprint 3, Strengthened Genes 2, Class Freak 3, Serendipity 3

![](/uploads/105593968-393111994979930-2181115729665396526-n-1.jpg)

## BUFFS

Like the Sniper, the Pistolero can work with the same buffs:

- 
 Small Weapons Bobbleheads (Rifles & Pistols) (+25% Damage)
- 
 Ballistics Bock (+15% damage)
- 
 Psychodeeds (+25% damage)
- 
 Magazines (+15% damage against Burnt or +15% damage against Animals)

## CONCLUSION

With a Bloodstained spec and sneak attacks, pistols are not as effective as rifles, but are still playable. Pistols play a little differently than, for example, the cleaner and the ammunition is cheaper. Having 45mm Ultrazit ammunition in bulk for rifles is more difficult than 10mm Ultrazit ammunition. In this respect you can save resources. The reload time is also extremely good, especially with 10mm pistols, so you hardly have any problems keeping the enemy at bay. If you feel like it, you can also play single-shot pistols and dress up in a cowboy outfit.

All in all, something different than just automatic rifles.
